title: 并行分派与证据汇总
prompt: Multi-agent runtime acceptance test MA-VISIBLE-001. Read only: do not create, edit, or delete files. Spawn three shared_read_only agents in parallel with agent_type=inherit_eval and task_name facts, constraints, risks. facts reads evidence/facts.txt and returns three facts. constraints reads evidence/constraints.txt and returns three constraints. risks reads evidence/risks.txt and returns the high, medium, and low risks. Spawn all three before waiting. Use wait_agents until all three are terminal; leave no orphan agent. The final answer must show MA-VISIBLE-001, each canonical path, terminal status, delegated result, and exactly `PARALLEL_DISPATCH: PASS` or a failure reason. The root agent must not read the evidence itself.
